title: Patch v0.3.4: Degrade is Nerf and Upgrade is Buff
notes: Degrade is renamed Nerf and Upgrade is renamed Buff on every card that printed them, both faces, with their numbers kept: Withering Storm, Buff Billy, Chaos Machine, Book of Buff, Book of Nerf, Call to Chaos (Classic+ Edition), Fine-Tuning and Heroic Power's Radiant Steady Shot. Only the words change; the cards play as before (R1320).
